title: Parallel algorithms with execution policies
hints: `std::transform_reduce(std::execution::par, v.begin(), v.end(), 0.0, std::plus<>{}, [](double x){ return x * x; })`.
For `normalize`, compute the mean first, then `std::transform(std::execution::par, ...)` in place. The lambda writes only to its own element, so there is no race.
